caveats: A few events prove the machinery, not the forecasting power: every rate here rests on a handful of places for one or two events. One graded place moves a hit rate by tens of points. Read these as a worked, auditable comparison, not a skill estimate. The simulator's traffic is modelled from lane structure, not the historical fleet.

capacity_loss_basis.text: The loss figure is stated by the source: gross tonnage of ships entering the Gulf of Aden fell >70% between the 1st half of Dec 2023 and the 1st half of Feb 2024; taken as 0.7 (the stated floor). Corroborated in the same timeline by Suez transits -70% by Jun 2024 (UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport 2024). No arithmetic conversion applied. Container-ship capacity fell further (-92% by Jun 2024); 0.7 is the conservative all-shipping figure.
